title: AI-assisted troubleshooting for Lakebase with telemetry in Unity Catalog (Beta)
body: Lakebase now surfaces database issues and early warnings with [Insights](/aws/en/oltp/projects/observability-ai-insights), and lets you investigate and fix them conversationally with [Genie](/aws/en/oltp/projects/observability-genie), using telemetry captured to Unity Catalog. See [AI-assisted troubleshooting](/aws/en/oltp/projects/ai-assisted-troubleshooting).
